response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mm AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - mm.mean_rate AS diff FROM r, mm WHERE r.rate > mm.mean_rate
